title: 加 cross_epic_docs_reuse_rate metric + 修 collect_filescope root ticket bug
description:
EPIC-253 — 补 Rule 36 指标 #2 的 docs-only 盲点, 且修 collect_filescope root ticket 漏扫 bug (主公 2026-08-13 拍板 Sprint 规划 #3).

**起因**: retrospective-batch-8 L14 记录 cross_epic_reuse_rate 对 docs-only EPIC 常年 0% / NO_DATA. 调查发现 2 个问题:

**Bug A (真 bug, 意外发现)**: collect_filescope_for_epic 只扫 JIRA_TICKETS_DIR/EPIC-XXX-*/ (sub-ticket glob), 漏 root ticket EPIC-XXX/. 所有 root-ticket 形态的 EPIC (EPIC-251/159/174 等) file_scope 都收集不到 → total_files=0 → NO_DATA. collect_filescope_all_except 的排除判断同样只匹配 sub 形态, 导致目标 EPIC 自己的文件泄漏进 others 集合.

**Gap B (设计缺口)**: 即便修好 bug A, docs-only EPIC 的 file_scope 多为一次性路径 (jira/tickets/EPIC-XXX/), 复用率天然低, 60% 阈值不适用.

**核心改动**:
1. 修 bug A: collect_filescope_for_epic + collect_filescope_all_except 加 root ticket 路径 (同 compute_mis_dispatch_binding_rate:571 已有的 root+sub 双路径写法)
2. 加 compute_cross_epic_docs_reuse_rate: 用 DOCS_PATH_PATTERN 过滤 docs 类路径, 阈值 40%
3. 集成到 format_json_metrics (m2b) + format_markdown_metrics (docs 行)
4. CLAUDE.md 3.2 Rule 36 加指标 2b

**scope**: 0 改 immutable script, 0 增 Rule (指标 2b 是 Rule 36 副指标, 非新 Rule).
acceptance: AC1: collect_filescope_for_epic 扫到 root ticket (raw: test Case 2 root ticket EPIC-901 file_scope collected = 3)
AC2: sub-ticket 形态无 regression (raw: test Case 3 = 3)
AC3: collect_filescope_all_except 排除 root + sub 两种形态 (raw: test Case 4)
AC4: compute_cross_epic_docs_reuse_rate 只算 docs 路径, 排除 .ts (raw: test Case 5 docs count = 2, 不含 foo.ts)
AC5: docs metric 阈值判定正确 (raw: test Case 6 full overlap >= 40 target → PASS)
AC6: 无 docs 的 EPIC → NO_DATA (raw: test Case 7)
AC7: metric 集成 JSON + Markdown formatter (raw: test Case 8)
AC9: 实测区分度 — EPIC-174 总复用 33% FAIL 但 docs 复用 42% PASS (raw: sprint-metrics.sh --epic EPIC-174)
AC10: CLAUDE.md ≤ 200 行 + §3.2 Rule 36 加指标 2b

AC11: 修 2 immutable script 的 delete-only diff bug (主公 2026-08-13 亲自批准, CLAUDE.md §5): grep '^+' 无匹配返回 1 在 set -euo pipefail 下静默 exit 1 → 误判 violation. 修法加 || true, 不放宽检查语义 (test Case 10 证新增 jargon 仍拦)
AC12: 4-branch flow 走完 (feature → testing → main → miao)
deliverables: scripts/metrics/lib/metrics.sh 改 (修 2 函数 bug + 加 compute_cross_epic_docs_reuse_rate + 2 formatter 集成)
scripts/verify/check-decorative-claim.sh 改 (immutable #1, 主公亲自批准, delete-only diff bug)
scripts/verify/check-evidence-fake.sh 改 (immutable #5, 主公亲自批准, 同 bug)
tests/integration/immutable-staged-only.test.sh 改 (加 Case 9/10 锚定 delete-only bug fix)
